unique_data_goal.independence: 12 predefined scenario families; all variants/colors share family split; shared and old-r3 split symmetries excluded. Not independent human games.

evaluation.criterion: Only validation-selected best is evaluated against r3. Require complete valid 32 stress games, score >0.5 at each clock and family-cluster bootstrap one-sided 95% lower >0.5, opening/defense move-screen major errors strictly reduced and mean regret <=0.9*r3, general/attack major errors not increased and mean regret <=r3+50cp. Also unknown scalar general/attack loss <=1.03*r3. No automatic adoption; Astra reviews. 4 unique clock/color startpos demonstrations are separate. No success-based early exit; failures retained, maxplies draw, time forfeits adverse.

controller: off; r3 continuation and fixed-depth relabeling are not a new control mechanism

model.objective: all-layer scalar smooth L1 cp/600, exact Q20/f64 accumulation; no nonterminal handcrafted scores
model.selection: one best validation export constrained by general and attack_end loss <=1.03 initial r3; two latest coherent resume checkpoints; development_test never selects best

state_machine.binding: run_id and run_sha256; code file hashes, not documentation-only HEAD equality

recovery: Resume valid parent shards and exact cursor under revision 2; preserve original deadline, swap baseline and retries. No training checkpoint exists before train.

Typed incomplete depth is excluded from labels and deferred to a finite fair hard queue; root incomplete alone never stops the run. Main 2M plus hard 32M share persistent two-attempt/34M-node/120-second task budget, including imported attempts.
Worker communication failure restarts only that worker within its persisted recovery budget. Independent-task health circuit and integrity/resource failures stop the affected stage.
Complete accepted manifests may retain bounded local deferrals; unmet coverage automatically uses sealed same-family supplementation then returns only the deficient stage to Astra.
Probe runs only generation through the supervised resume path and pauses ready_for_luna before preparation/training.

34M is the cumulative requested node budget; teacher node counters may overshoot their request. Persist observed nodes and enforce each 60-second wall deadline. Teacher circuit uses 24 failures in the latest 32 distinct tasks across at least 8 games.

Reviewed startup/stdio-only fixes use the same run and immutable run/seal, with committed operational file hashes and original failure/state/log prefixes in execution attempts. Only evaluator_run.py and the operations section of this source config may differ; teacher, data, training, resources and evaluation remain sealed.

resume acquires the live lease, excludes residual processes, verifies output receipts and native checkpoint replay, records the operation revision and attempt, and starts a fresh supervisor/stage with DEVNULL runner stdin and append logs. Confirmed before-spawn or unregistered CPython init_sys_streams EBADF failures are recoverable; data-writing and unknown failures remain needs_astra. No automatic EBADF retry or budget reset.

pause waits for the supervisor/stage lease to be released, verifies durable progress and returns ready_for_luna. Luna may execute the verified resume/pause commands without reapproval; no new run, reseal, data clone or model publication is authorized.

Astra performs approve-operations once after code review and commit; it pins the allowed operational hashes without changing state or the original seal. Luna only resumes that approved revision; resume never approves new code hashes automatically.
return_to_astra: identity, split, corruption, numerical or illegal-move integrity failure
resource danger or independent-task teacher-health circuit
coverage remains insufficient after finite hard-queue and same-family supplementation
awaiting_astra_review after valid fixed evaluation regardless of win rate
